rachel: Heads-up: I9d like to land a pragmatic long-term routing approach for multi-region + multi-tenant isolation. Proposal summary: 1) define three runtime tiers (premium, standard, pooled), 2) treat compliance as an orthogonal flag, 3) evaluate composition at request-time instead of pre-provisioning every slice. Goal: limit slice-count while meeting SLAs. initial reactions?

 dan: sounds pragmatic. biggest risk is cache fragmentation and p95 regressions for smaller tenants moved into pooled. we need quantitative sims.

 taylor: from product: sales already has two requests that would be premium-ready (finance & edtech). they want region+model pin for compliance. Product needs clear onboarding flow + console controls.

 nina: ops: fallback semantics are important. propose deterministic selection: stable-hash(tenant_id) -> preferred-slice, fallback to band-level pool. also require an evacuation playbook for soft-evict vs hard-evict.

 omar: policy complexity note: composing at request-time will require a compact policy language. prefer rules with explicit precedence and an isolated "compliance" namespace so we can force region/model pins.

 rachel: pilot plan: run 2 pilots concurrently: pilot-premium (2 paying tenants on dedicated regional slices) + pilot-standard (10 tenants on shared slices with soft-affinity). collect: p50/p95/p99, cache hit-rate, cost/100k tokens, onboarding friction.

 dan: dev estimate: policy engine + grammar = 2 sprints, control-plane ops + consoles = 1 sprint, runtime changes + eviction tooling = 2 sprints, pilot + metrics = 1 sprint.

 taylor: launch criteria suggestion: premium p95 within 10% of dedicated baseline; premium availability >= 99.95%; migration window and warm-up tokens for migration; cost within 20% of forecast.

 nina: runbook checklist: automated evacuation command, mark readonly -> drain inflight (120s) -> redirect -> scale fallback if latency > threshold, and SLA-breach alerting to CS and oncall. include chaos tests for eviction flows.

 omar: action items: @dan run cache impact sim with 60/30/10 traffic split, @taylor gather customer model-pin requests and pricing willingness, @rachel draft compact policy grammar RFC, @nina draft evacuation playbook. follow-up sync Fri 9am (20m).

 policy-bot: Created incident channel: #pilot-routing-evicts

 rachel: Thanks all :thumbsup:
